title: Pan-Seared Cod with Norwegian Sauce
description: A delicate cod dish smothered in a rich Norwegian sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 2. Season cod fillets with salt and pepper.
3. Heat butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
4. Sear cod for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to the oven.
5. Bake cod for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, heat Norwegian sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
7. Stir in chopped grill and remove from heat.
8. Serve cod with Norwegian sauce spooned over the top.
9. Garnish with velvety sauce and bitter greens, if desired.
